name: Strawberry Greek Yogurt Parfait Cup (No Granola)
whyItWorks: Strained Greek yogurt provides rich protein and probiotic cultures, while soft ripe strawberries deliver antioxidants. Skipping hard seed-heavy oat granola protects narrowing gut lumen.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the parfait without granola topping (or discard granola packet). Safe if lactose tolerant or taking lactase.
